# Projection calibration

<!-- Generated by `npm run bench:calibrate:report`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Commit `e9ebf96`, 2026-09-05. Node v24.11.1, 14 cores, CI=false, CPU local (model withheld).

**Control workload 13.28 ms.** Divide by this to compare across machines.

Sweep: 1000, 2000, 5000, 8000, 10000, 12500, 15000, 20000, 25000, 30000, 35000, 40000, 50000, 60000, 75000, 100000, 150000, 200000 target rows. Partial-method store: 1,000,000 nodes. 3 independent repeats of 60 samples each, seed 42.

**This document chooses no threshold.** It locates where the existing projection crosses a
4ms structural-change budget. Budget `B` is derived in M1 commit 3.

## Where each shape crosses 4 ms

Highest row count still inside the budget, and lowest row count outside it. The true
crossing lies between them; the sweep resolves it no more finely than that.

| shape | method | last inside | first outside | crossing bracket |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| shallow-wide | partial | 25,008 | 30,044 | 25,008 to 30,044 |
| shallow-wide | sized | 40,000 | 50,000 | 40,000 to 50,000 |
| deep-narrow | partial | 15,001 | 20,001 | 15,001 to 20,001 |
| deep-narrow | sized | 15,000 | 20,000 | 15,000 to 20,000 |
| balanced | partial | 25,000 | 30,002 | 25,000 to 30,002 |
| balanced | sized | 40,000 | 50,000 | 40,000 to 50,000 |
| sparse-unbalanced | partial | 21,485 | 29,401 | 21,485 to 29,401 |
| sparse-unbalanced | sized | 50,000 | 60,000 | 50,000 to 60,000 |
| mega-sibling | partial | no reachable points | no reachable points | not measurable |
| mega-sibling | sized | 50,000 | 60,000 | 50,000 to 60,000 |

Across the **partial** method, which is the state M1 actually produces, the most constrained combination is **deep-narrow** at **15,001 rows**. Any single conservative budget must sit at or below that.

Per shape, the sized method is far less constrained on three of four measurable shapes, and identical on deep-narrow. Worst case therefore agrees between methods while the typical case does not, which is why quoting an average across shapes would be misleading in either direction.

## Stability near the crossing

Spread across the three independent repeats, partial method, for points between 8,000 and
50,000 rows. This is the region a budget would be drawn from.

| statistic | median spread | worst spread | worst as share of the 4 ms budget |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| p50 | 0.089 ms | 1.430 ms | 36% |
| p99 | 0.859 ms | 5.286 ms | 132% |

p99 over sixty samples is dominated by collection pauses and outliers. Its repeat-to-repeat spread is a substantial fraction of the budget itself, so the p99 crossing brackets above should be read as approximate. p50 is stable to within a few percent and its crossing is well located, but it is the wrong statistic to gate a frame budget on, because a frame that misses is a frame the reader sees.

**This document does not resolve that tension.** Choosing which statistic gates the budget, and what safety factor absorbs the noise in it, is a commit 3 decision made in the open.
